newsitem.title: USA: South Carolina House approves $250 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: South Carolina House approves $250 mln bond issue.

text.p: South Carolina's House of Representatives approved a $250 million general obligation bond bill for capital improvements.
The proposal passed Wednesday and now goes to the Senate, legislative officials said.

The bill would raise $145.5 million for school construction and renovation, $54.7 million for prisons and about $50 million for other projects, including $10 million to buy the Jocassee Gorge wilderness area in Pickens County.
